mapper.select: WITH items AS ( SELECT l.id,l.entry_type,l.business_time,l.business_date,l.created_at, CASE WHEN l.entry_type='EXPENSE' THEN l.product_name_snapshot ELSE l.income_name END AS title, CASE WHEN l.entry_type='EXPENSE' THEN concat_ws(' / ',l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot) ELSE l.income_category_name_snapshot END AS category_name, CASE WHEN l.entry_type='EXPENSE' THEN concat_ws(' · ',l.quantity || ' ' || l.unit_name_snapshot, l.purchase_channel_name_snapshot,l.location_label_name_snapshot) ELSE l.payer_name_snapshot END AS counterparty_name, l.funding_channel_id,l.funding_channel_name_snapshot, CASE WHEN l.entry_type='EXPENSE' THEN l.paid_amount ELSE l.income_amount END AS amount,l.note, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS adjustment_type,CAST(NULL AS uuid) AS original_expense_id, CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS effective_adjustment_amount,CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS net_expense_amount,false AS fully_adjusted, l.version,l.lifecycle_status,l.deleted_at,l.purge_after, LEAST(30,GREATEST(0,CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l.purge_after-CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))/86400)))::integer AS remaining_days, (SELECT count(*) FROM expense_adjustment linked WHERE linked.original_expense_id=l.id) AS linked_count, concat_ws(' ',l.product_name_snapshot,l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot, l.income_name,l.payer_name_snapshot,l.income_category_name_snapshot,l.funding_channel_name_snapshot, l.purchase_channel_name_snapshot,l.location_label_name_snapshot,l.note) AS search_text FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.lifecycle_status='TRASHED' UNION ALL SELECT a.id,'ADJUSTMENT',a.business_time,a.business_date,a.created_at, CASE a.adjustment_type WHEN 'REFUND' THEN '退款' ELSE '报销' END, CASE a.adjustment_type WHEN 'REFUND' THEN '支出退款' ELSE '费用报销' END, '原支出 · ' || l.product_name_snapshot,l.funding_channel_id,l.funding_channel_name_snapshot, a.amount,a.note,a.adjustment_type,a.original_expense_id,CAST(NULL AS numeric),CAST(NULL AS numeric),false, a.version,a.status,a.deleted_at,a.purge_after, LEAST(30,GREATEST(0,CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.purge_after-CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))/86400)))::integer,0, concat_ws(' ',l.product_name_snapshot,l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot, l.funding_channel_name_snapshot,a.note,CASE a.adjustment_type WHEN 'REFUND' THEN '退款' ELSE '报销' END) FROM expense_adjustment a JOIN ledger_entry l ON l.id=a.original_expense_id WHERE a.status='TRASHED' ) SELECT FROM items WHERE true AND (deleted_at,id) < (#{p.cursorDeleted},#{p.cursorId}) ORDER BY deleted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{p.limit}
